description: Read and organize Adobe Lightroom catalogs, albums, and assets in a Creative Cloud account. Standard OAuth2 (Adobe IMS authorization-code grant) against the Lightroom Services API at lr.adobe.io.

capabilities.name: ims.userinfo
capabilities.description: Read the authenticated Adobe ID profile (sub, name, email, account_type) from Adobe IMS. Useful as a non-Lightroom self-test that exercises the access token without needing a catalog.

capabilities.name: account.get
capabilities.description: Read Lightroom account metadata for the authenticated user (subscription tier, storage quota, default catalog id).

capabilities.name: catalogs.list
capabilities.description: Enumerate the Lightroom catalogs visible to the authenticated user. Most accounts have exactly one catalog; team plans surface multiple.

capabilities.name: catalogs.get
capabilities.description: Read one Lightroom catalog by id (returns catalog name, created, updated, asset count, and capability flags).

capabilities.name: albums.list
capabilities.description: List albums under a catalog. Returns a `links.next` href when paginated; pass `name_after` to resume.

name_after.description: Pagination cursor returned in `links.next` from a prior page.

capabilities.name: albums.get
capabilities.description: Read one album by id within a catalog (album name, subtype, parent_id, cover asset).

capabilities.name: albums.create
capabilities.description: Create an album under a catalog. The caller supplies the album UUID (Lightroom uses PUT with a client-chosen id), so re-issuing the same call is a deterministic replay.

album_id.description: Caller-supplied album UUID. Must be a v4 UUID; Lightroom dedupes by (catalog_id, album_id).

payload.description: AlbumPayload — { name, parent: { id } | null, cover: { id } | null, ... }.

capabilities.name: albums.update
capabilities.description: Update an album (rename, reparent, change cover). Lightroom honors `If-Match` against the album ETag; the declarative layer flags this as etag-if-match so the action guard reads-before-writes.

payload.description: AlbumUpdatePayload — partial set of mutable fields (name, parent, cover).

capabilities.name: albums.delete
capabilities.description: Delete an album. Lightroom soft-deletes the album record but does NOT delete the contained assets (they remain in the catalog under "All Photos").

capabilities.name: assets.list
capabilities.description: List assets in a catalog. Filters by subtype (image | video), capture date range, and a cursor for incremental enumeration.

captured_after.description: ISO8601 lower bound on capture timestamp.

captured_before.description: ISO8601 upper bound on capture timestamp.

name_after.description: Pagination cursor returned in `links.next` from a prior page.

capabilities.name: assets.get
capabilities.description: Read one asset by id within a catalog. Returns the asset payload (capture metadata, develop settings, rendition links).

capabilities.name: file.upload
capabilities.description: Upload a file (create a Lightroom asset). The caller supplies the asset UUID; Lightroom dedupes by (catalog_id, asset_id) so replays are deterministic.

asset_id.description: Caller-supplied asset UUID (v4); Lightroom dedupes by (catalog_id, asset_id).

capabilities.name: file.delete
capabilities.description: Delete a file (Lightroom asset) by id. Lightroom marks the asset as deleted; rendition references are GC-collected asynchronously.

capabilities.name: folder.create
capabilities.description: Create a folder (Lightroom collection_set album). The caller supplies the folder UUID; PUT with the same UUID is a deterministic replay.

album_id.description: Caller-supplied folder/album UUID (v4); Lightroom dedupes by (catalog_id, album_id).

payload.description: AlbumPayload — { name, parent: { id } | null, subtype: "collection_set" }.

capabilities.name: assets.list_in_album
capabilities.description: List the assets attached to a specific album within a catalog. Use the `links.next` cursor to page.

name_after.description: Pagination cursor returned in `links.next` from a prior page.

marker.description: Opaque continuation marker from a previous response.

capabilities.name: containers.create

capabilities.name: containers.delete

capabilities.name: blobs.list

capabilities.name: blobs.findByTags

capabilities.name: blobs.read

capabilities.name: blobs.upload
capabilities.description: Upload or replace a block blob from UTF-8 or base64 content.

capabilities.name: blobs.delete

capabilities.name: blobs.tags.set
capabilities.description: Replace blob index tags or merge them with the current tags.

capabilities.name: cloudEvents.publish

capabilities.name: audio.speech.create

capabilities.name: subscriptions.list

capabilities.name: subscriptions.get

capabilities.name: topics.send

brokerProperties.description: Allowed broker properties such as MessageId, CorrelationId, Label, SessionId, TimeToLive, and ScheduledEnqueueTimeUtc.

capabilities.description: Receive and permanently delete the next queue message.

capabilities.name: subscriptions.receiveDelete
capabilities.description: Receive and permanently delete the next message from a topic subscription.

capabilities.name: queues.deadLetters.receiveDelete

capabilities.name: subscriptions.deadLetters.receiveDelete
capabilities.description: Receive and permanently delete the next subscription dead-letter message.

description: Read and upload objects on a Backblaze B2 bucket via the S3-compatible REST API at s3.{region}.backblazeb2.com.

auth.hint: Backblaze B2 application key pair as JSON: {"accessKeyId":"…","secretAccessKey":"…","region":"us-west-001","bucket":"…"} scoped to the target bucket. Optional "endpoint" overrides the host. Requests are signed with AWS Signature V4 (S3-compatible); the region selects the s3.<region>.backblazeb2.com endpoint.

capabilities.name: files.read
capabilities.description: Read an object from the configured bucket. Returns the object bytes and S3 response headers (Content-Type, Content-Length, ETag, x-amz-meta-*). `key` is the full object key including any extension; folder-style keys use forward slashes.

bucket.description: Bucket name. Defaults to the connector-configured bucket when omitted.

key.description: Full object key (e.g. "reports/2026/q1.pdf"). Include the extension verbatim — Backblaze treats keys as opaque byte strings.

capabilities.name: files.s3_upload
capabilities.description: Upload an object to the bucket via S3 PutObject. The destination key is built from `folderPath` + `fileName` when both are present, otherwise `fileName` is used as the full key. `type` selects the Content-Type sent on the PUT, and `acl` maps to the S3 canned-ACL header (private | public-read).

bucket.description: Bucket name. Defaults to the connector-configured bucket when omitted.

fileName.description: File name without extension by activepieces convention. Combined with `folderPath` to form the destination key; pass a full path here (e.g. "reports/q1.pdf") to store at the bucket root.

folderPath.description: Optional folder prefix (e.g. "reports/2026"). Joined to `fileName` with a single "/" separator.

file.description: Object body. Pass a base64-encoded string for binary content, or a UTF-8 string for text. The runtime decodes and sets Content-Length.

type.description: MIME type sent as the Content-Type header (e.g. "application/pdf", "image/png"). Required by the activepieces piece.

acl.description: S3 canned ACL applied to the new object. Backblaze honors `private` and `public-read`; other canned ACLs are rejected.

capabilities.name: files.list
capabilities.description: List objects in the bucket using S3 ListObjectsV2. `prefix` narrows the listing to a key prefix; `maxKeys` caps the number of returned keys (S3 cap is 1000).

bucket.description: Bucket name. Defaults to the connector-configured bucket when omitted.

prefix.description: Only list keys that start with this prefix (e.g. "reports/2026/").

maxKeys.description: Maximum number of keys to return (1..1000). Defaults to 1000.

continuationToken.description: Opaque token from a previous response when paginating.

capabilities.name: files.delete
capabilities.description: Delete an object from the bucket via S3 DeleteObject. The key is opaque — pass the full key including any folder prefix.

bucket.description: Bucket name. Defaults to the connector-configured bucket when omitted.

key.description: Full object key (e.g. "reports/2026/q1.pdf"). Include the extension verbatim.

capabilities.name: files.copy
capabilities.description: Server-side copy of an object to a new key in the same (or another) bucket via S3 PUT + x-amz-copy-source. `sourceKey` is the full source object key; `destKey` is the destination key.

bucket.description: Destination bucket name. Defaults to the connector-configured bucket when omitted.

sourceBucket.description: Source bucket name. Defaults to `bucket` when omitted.

acl.description: S3 canned ACL applied to the new object.

description: Read and update BambooHR employee records, time-off requests, custom reports, and employee files via the BambooHR Gateway REST API.

auth.hint: BambooHR API key. Generate one under your BambooHR account → API Keys, then paste the base64 of `<apiKey>:x` (the literal letter x as password — BambooHR ignores the password but HTTP Basic requires one).

capabilities.name: employees.directory
capabilities.description: List every employee in the BambooHR directory (id, displayName, jobTitle, workEmail, department, location, supervisor). Useful as a tenant-wide lookup table.

capabilities.name: employees.get
capabilities.description: Fetch a single employee record by id. Pass `fields` as a comma-separated list of BambooHR field aliases (firstName,lastName,workEmail,jobTitle,hireDate,…).

employeeId.description: BambooHR employee id (or "0" for the API-key owner).

fields.description: Comma-separated field aliases to project; required by BambooHR.

capabilities.name: employees.create
capabilities.description: Create a new employee. Body is a flat object of BambooHR field aliases (firstName, lastName, workEmail, jobTitle, department, hireDate). BambooHR returns the new employee id in the `Location` response header.

fields.description: Flat map of BambooHR field aliases → values. firstName and lastName are required.

capabilities.name: employees.update
capabilities.description: Update an existing employee. Body is a flat object of BambooHR field aliases → new values. BambooHR returns 200 with no body on success.

capabilities.name: employees.list_custom_table
capabilities.description: Read a row set from a BambooHR table (jobInfo, compensation, employmentStatus, …) for a single employee. Returns one entry per historical row.

tableName.description: BambooHR table alias, e.g. jobInfo, compensation, employmentStatus.

capabilities.name: timeoff.types.list
capabilities.description: List the time-off types configured for the tenant (vacation, sick, jury duty, …). Returns id, name, units.

capabilities.name: timeoff.requests.list
capabilities.description: List time-off requests in a date window. `start` and `end` are ISO-8601 dates (YYYY-MM-DD); `status` filters by approved/denied/superseded/requested.

type.description: Time-off type id.

capabilities.name: timeoff.requests.create
capabilities.description: File a time-off request on behalf of an employee. status defaults to "requested" so it routes through the tenant's normal approval chain.

amount.description: Hours or days depending on the time-off type units.

notes.description: Free-form notes; BambooHR shows them on the request.

capabilities.name: timeoff.requests.change_status
capabilities.description: Approve, deny, or cancel an existing time-off request. status must be one of approved | denied | superseded | requested | canceled.

capabilities.name: reports.list
capabilities.description: List the tenant's saved custom reports (id, name, owner). Use the id with `reports.run`.

capabilities.name: reports.run
capabilities.description: Run a saved BambooHR report by id and return its rows. format defaults to JSON; set fd=yes to flatten field aliases into the response keys.

capabilities.name: reports.custom
capabilities.description: Build an ad-hoc report from a list of field aliases. Body matches BambooHR's custom-report contract: { title, fields, filters?, includeWorkflowStatus? }.

fields.description: BambooHR field aliases to include as report columns.

capabilities.name: files.list
capabilities.description: List the files attached to an employee (id, name, originalFileName, size, dateCreated, category).

capabilities.name: files.get_metadata
capabilities.description: Fetch a single employee file's metadata by id. To download bytes, the caller follows the returned URL with the same credentials.

capabilities.name: meta.fields
capabilities.description: List every BambooHR field the tenant has configured (alias, name, type). Use this to discover field aliases dynamically.

capabilities.name: meta.lists
capabilities.description: List the tenant's list-typed field options (departments, divisions, locations, employment statuses).

description: Automate image generation using Bannerbear templates.

auth.hint: Bannerbear API key.

capabilities.name: images.create
capabilities.description: Create an image using a Bannerbear template with specified modifications.

templateId.description: The ID of the template to use for image creation.

modifications.description: A list of modifications to apply to the template layers.

templateVersion.description: Create image based on a specific version of the template.

transparent.description: Render a PNG with a transparent background. Default is false.

renderPdf.description: Render a PDF instead of a PNG. Default is false.

metadata.description: Any metadata you need to store, e.g., ID of a record in your DB.

capabilities.name: images.delete
capabilities.description: Delete a previously-rendered image by its Bannerbear image id.

imageId.description: Bannerbear image id (uid returned by images.create).

capabilities.name: videos.create
capabilities.description: Render a video from a Bannerbear video template. Pass the Bannerbear video-create body directly (snake_case fields: video_template, modifications, input_media_url, blur_media_url, frames, frames_per_row, metadata, webhook_url).

modifications.description: Per-layer modifications applied to the video template (text/image/colour overrides).

input_media_url.description: URL to source media when the template ingests external footage.

blur_media_url.description: URL to media used as background blur (template-specific).

frames.description: Per-frame modifications for multi-frame video templates.

frames_per_row.description: Layout hint for multi-frame templates (frames per row).

metadata.description: Free-form metadata stored on the video render.

webhook_url.description: Callback URL invoked when the video render completes.

capabilities.name: collections.create
capabilities.description: Create a Bannerbear collection render — a single API call that fans out one set of modifications across every template attached to the collection template. Pass the body directly (snake_case fields: template_set, modifications, transparent, render_pdf, metadata, webhook_url).

modifications.description: Per-layer modifications applied to every template in the set.

transparent.description: Render PNGs with transparent backgrounds. Default false.

render_pdf.description: Render PDFs instead of PNGs. Default false.

metadata.description: Free-form metadata stored on the collection render.

webhook_url.description: Callback URL invoked when the collection render completes.

description: Read projects, message boards, to-do lists, to-dos, and campfire chats from a connected Basecamp 3 account; create message-board posts, to-dos, and campfire lines.

capabilities.name: projects.list
capabilities.description: List active projects visible to the authorized user. Paginates 15 per page; use `page` to walk.

status.description: Filter by archived/trashed lifecycle. Defaults to active when omitted.

capabilities.name: projects.get
capabilities.description: Read a single project, including the dock of tools (message board, todoset, campfire, schedule) attached to it.

capabilities.name: projects.create
capabilities.description: Create a new project. Returns the project payload with its dock of default tools attached.

capabilities.name: message_board.messages.list
capabilities.description: List messages on a project message board. `messageBoardId` is the id of the message_board tool from projects.get.

capabilities.name: message_board.messages.get
capabilities.description: Read a single message-board post by id.

capabilities.name: message_board.messages.create
capabilities.description: Post a new active message to a project message board. `content` is HTML (Basecamp's rich-text format); `subject` is plain text. Published immediately (status="active").

content.description: HTML body. Basecamp strips disallowed tags server-side.

capabilities.name: todoset.get
capabilities.description: Read the project's todoset (the container that holds all to-do lists). `todosetId` is the id of the todoset tool from projects.get.

capabilities.name: todolists.list
capabilities.description: List to-do lists inside a todoset.

capabilities.name: todolists.create
capabilities.description: Create a new to-do list inside a todoset. `name` and `description` are both required body fields here; Basecamp accepts an empty `description` if the list has none.

description.description: Plain text; pass an empty string if none.

capabilities.name: todos.list
capabilities.description: List to-dos inside a single to-do list. Use `status=archived|trashed|completed` to slice.

capabilities.name: todos.get
capabilities.description: Read a single to-do by id, including assignees, due date, and completion state.

capabilities.name: todos.create
capabilities.description: Create a to-do inside a to-do list. Body fields follow Basecamp's wire format verbatim: `content` (required), `description` (HTML), `assignee_ids` / `notify_ids` / `completion_subscriber_ids` (arrays of person ids), `due_on` and `starts_on` (ISO YYYY-MM-DD). Path-only args (`projectId`, `todolistId`) are scrubbed by Basecamp server-side.

capabilities.name: todos.update
capabilities.description: Edit an existing to-do. Wire field names match Basecamp directly (`content`, `description`, `assignee_ids`, `notify_ids`, `due_on`, `starts_on`). Omitted fields are left untouched server-side.

capabilities.name: todos.complete
capabilities.description: Mark a to-do completed. Idempotent on Basecamp's side — re-POSTing on an already-completed to-do is a no-op 204.

capabilities.name: todos.uncomplete
capabilities.description: Reopen a previously completed to-do.

capabilities.name: comments.list
capabilities.description: List comments attached to a recording (to-do, message, document, upload — any commentable resource).

recordingId.description: Id of the parent recording (to-do, message, etc.).

capabilities.name: comments.create
capabilities.description: Post a comment on any commentable recording. `content` is HTML.

capabilities.name: campfire.lines.list
capabilities.description: List recent lines (messages) in a project's campfire (group chat). `campfireId` is the id of the chat tool from projects.get.

capabilities.name: campfire.lines.create
capabilities.description: Post a single line to a project's campfire chat. `content` is HTML.

capabilities.name: people.list
capabilities.description: List people on the account. Use this to resolve assignee ids for to-do creation.

capabilities.name: people.get
capabilities.description: Read a single person on the account.

description: Run a DocumentPro extract Workflow against a previously uploaded document and receive the structured fields parsed by the AI pipeline.

capabilities.name: run.extract
capabilities.description: Run an extract / Workflow against a previously uploaded document and return the structured fields produced by the configured template. Optional flags toggle OCR, layout / table detection, page selection, and regex-based segmentation.

document_id.description: ID returned by the upload endpoint (POST /v1/documents). Identifies the file to parse.

template_id.description: ID of the Workflow / template to run. Templates are created in the DocumentPro UI and define the fields to extract.

use_ocr.description: Enable the OCR pipeline. Required when using gpt-3.5-turbo or any OCR-dependent flag (layout, tables, regex segmentation).

query_model.description: AI model used for parsing (e.g. "gpt-4o", "gpt-3.5-turbo"). Defaults to the template setting if omitted.

detect_layout.description: Detect document layout (columns, headers, blocks). Requires use_ocr=true.

detect_tables.description: Detect tables and emit them as structured rows. Requires use_ocr=true.

page_ranges.description: Which pages to parse, e.g. "1-3,5,7-9". Empty / omitted = all pages.

chunk_by_pages.description: Pages per segment for method-1 segmentation. Pass 0 / omit to disable.

rolling_window.description: Window size in pages for method-2 segmentation. Pass 0 / omit to disable.

start_regex.description: Regex marking where parsing should begin within the document text. Requires use_ocr=true.

end_regex.description: Regex marking where parsing should stop. Requires use_ocr=true.

split_regex.description: Regex used to split the document into sections before extraction. Requires use_ocr=true.

use_all_matches.description: When true, every regex match yields a section; when false, only the first match is used. Requires use_ocr=true.

capabilities.name: documents.delete
capabilities.description: Delete a previously uploaded DocumentPro document and its associated extraction history. Cannot be undone.

document_id.description: ID of the document to remove (returned by the upload endpoint).

document_id.description: ID of the document whose extraction should be exported.

template_id.description: Template / Workflow whose extraction is being exported. Required when a document has multiple templates run against it.

format.description: Export format. Defaults to json on the upstream when omitted.

capabilities.description: Run a core report against a GA4 property. Pass dimensions, metrics, dateRanges (e.g. {startDate:"7daysAgo",endDate:"today"}), optional filters, ordering, and a row limit. Returns the rows, totals, and metadata GA4 emits in the standard runReport response (POST /v1beta/properties/{propertyId}:runReport).

dateRanges.description: One or two date ranges; GA4 accepts ISO dates ("2026-05-01"), "today", "yesterday", or "NdaysAgo".

limit.description: Max rows per page; GA4 caps at 250000.

currencyCode.description: ISO-4217 currency, overrides the property default for monetary metrics.

capabilities.name: properties.batchRunReports

requests.description: Up to 5 report requests; each takes the same shape as runReport (dimensions/metrics/dateRanges/etc.).

pageToken.description: Continuation token from a prior page response.

versions.description: Include non-current object versions in the response.

capabilities.name: objects.clone
capabilities.description: Server-side copy an object to a new bucket + name. Source and destination may live in different buckets.

sourceObject.description: Source object name (URL-encoded if it contains "/").

sourceGeneration.description: Pin the copy to a specific source generation (object version).

capabilities.name: objects.delete
capabilities.description: Delete an object. When the bucket has versioning enabled, pass `generation` to delete a specific version.

capabilities.name: bucket_acl.create
capabilities.description: Grant a role to an entity on the bucket-level ACL collection.

capabilities.name: bucket_acl.delete
capabilities.description: Revoke a bucket-level ACL grant from an entity.

capabilities.name: bucket_default_object_acl.create
capabilities.description: Add an entry to the bucket default object ACL. New objects created in the bucket inherit this grant unless overridden at insert time.

role.description: Role granted to the entity on newly-created objects.

capabilities.name: bucket_default_object_acl.delete
capabilities.description: Remove an entry from the bucket default object ACL.

capabilities.name: object_acl.create
capabilities.description: Grant a role to an entity on a specific object's ACL collection.

role.description: Role granted to the entity on this object.

generation.description: Specific object version to grant on; defaults to the current generation.

capabilities.name: object_acl.delete
capabilities.description: Revoke a per-object ACL grant from an entity.

generation.description: Specific object version to revoke from; defaults to the current generation.

description: Read, search, create, update, and delete personal Google contacts via the Google People API v1 (people.googleapis.com), including "Other contacts" and Workspace directory entries.

capabilities.name: people.get
capabilities.description: Read a single Person by resource name (e.g. "people/c12345678901234567"). `personFields` is required and selects which fields the response should populate.

resourceName.description: Person resource name like "people/{contact_id}" or "people/me" for the authenticated user.

personFields.description: Comma-separated list of person fields to return, e.g. "names,emailAddresses,phoneNumbers,organizations,addresses,biographies".

capabilities.name: people.list
capabilities.description: List the authenticated user's personal contacts ("people/me/connections"). Supports pagination and a sync token for incremental fetches.

personFields.description: Comma-separated list of person fields to return.

syncToken.description: Token from a previous response used to fetch only changes since that response.

requestSyncToken.description: Set true to request a syncToken in the response for later incremental sync.

capabilities.name: people.search
capabilities.description: Server-side prefix search over the user's contacts using "people:searchContacts". Returns ranked matches by name, email, phone, or organization.

query.description: Prefix to match against name, email, phone, or org fields.

capabilities.name: otherContacts.list
capabilities.description: "Other contacts" — addresses Google auto-imports from Gmail/Calendar interactions. Read-only and exposed under a separate scope.

capabilities.name: otherContacts.search
capabilities.description: Prefix search across "Other contacts".

capabilities.name: directory.list
capabilities.description: List Workspace directory people (org users + shared contacts). Available only on Google Workspace tenants where the admin enabled directory sharing.

mergeSources.description: DIRECTORY_MERGE_SOURCE_TYPE_CONTACT to merge personal contact data when available.

capabilities.name: directory.search
capabilities.description: Prefix search across the Workspace directory.

capabilities.name: people.create
capabilities.description: Create a new personal contact. The body is a full Person resource (names, emailAddresses, phoneNumbers, organizations, etc.). `personFields` selects which fields to return on the populated response.

person.description: Person resource body, e.g. { names: [{ givenName, familyName }], emailAddresses: [...] }.

capabilities.name: people.update
capabilities.description: Update a personal contact. `updatePersonFields` is required and is a comma-separated FieldMask of the mutated top-level fields. The Person body must include the current `etag` for optimistic concurrency.

updatePersonFields.description: Comma-separated FieldMask of mutated top-level fields, e.g. "names,emailAddresses".

personFields.description: Field mask selecting which fields the response should re-populate.

person.description: Person body with `etag` from the prior read and the new field values.

capabilities.name: people.delete
capabilities.description: Delete a personal contact by resource name.

capabilities.name: groups.create
capabilities.description: Create a user-owned contact group (label) via "contactGroups:create". `contactGroup.name` is the human-readable label. The People API has no Idempotency-Key on this endpoint; consecutive POSTs produce duplicate groups, so the MutationGuard layer must dedupe.

readGroupFields.description: Comma-separated FieldMask selecting which group fields the response should populate, e.g. "name,clientData".

capabilities.name: people.batchGet
capabilities.description: Read up to 200 contacts in one round trip. `resourceNames` is a repeated query parameter.

description: Read and draft into the user's Google Docs. Fetch a document's plaintext body, create a new doc from a title + initial body, and append text with optional revision-id CAS guarding concurrent edits.

capabilities.name: get_document
capabilities.description: Fetch a Google Doc by id. Returns the title, the plaintext body (paragraph + textRun blocks collapsed), the underlying structured content for callers that need it, and the current revisionId for use as CAS on subsequent writes.

documentId.description: Docs document id (the slug after /document/d/ in the URL).

capabilities.name: create_document
capabilities.description: Create a new Google Doc with the given title. When `body` is supplied the text is inserted at the start of the doc via a follow-up batchUpdate. Returns the new documentId + revisionId.

title.description: Title shown in Drive and the Docs tab.

body.description: Optional plaintext body to insert at index 1 immediately after create.

capabilities.name: append_text
capabilities.description: Append plaintext to the end of an existing Doc via a single insertText batchUpdate. When `requiredRevisionId` is supplied the request is rejected by Docs if any other writer has committed between read and write — surfaced as ResourceContention.

text.description: Plaintext to append (a leading newline is added if the doc is non-empty).

requiredRevisionId.description: Optional revisionId from a prior get_document; when present, request fails fast on a concurrent edit.

capabilities.name: delete_document
capabilities.description: Trash a Google Doc via the Drive API (PATCH /drive/v3/files/{id} with trashed=true). Trashing is idempotent: repeating the call leaves the file in the trash and yields the same response. Requires drive.file scope on a file this app created or opened.

documentId.description: Docs document id (also the Drive file id).

capabilities.name: export_document
capabilities.description: Export a Google Doc to PDF, HTML, plaintext, DOCX, ODT, RTF, EPUB, or Markdown via the Drive API export endpoint. Returns the exported bytes as a base64 string + the resolved mime type. `format` is a friendly alias (pdf|html|text|docx|odt|rtf|epub|markdown); pass `mimeType` to use any other Drive-supported export mime.

format.description: Friendly format alias: pdf, html, text, docx, odt, rtf, epub, markdown.

description: Read and watch files in the user's Google Drive. List a folder, fetch a document's contents (Docs/Sheets/PDFs/.docx), and subscribe to folder changes via push notifications.

capabilities.name: list_files
capabilities.description: List files visible to the connected Drive account. Optionally scope to a folder by id and/or pass a Drive query string (e.g., "mimeType='application/pdf' and modifiedTime > '2025-01-01T00:00:00Z'").

folderId.description: Drive folder id; when present, restricts to direct children.

query.description: Optional Drive query expression; appended with AND if folderId is set.

pageToken.description: Continuation token returned by a previous call.

capabilities.name: read_file
capabilities.description: Read a file's contents. Google-native types are exported (Docs → text/plain by default, Sheets → text/csv, Slides → application/pdf); binary types are returned as base64.

exportMime.description: Export mime override for Google-native types. Defaults: Docs=text/plain, Sheets=text/csv, Slides=application/pdf.

capabilities.name: watch_folder
capabilities.description: Create a push-notification channel for a folder. Drive POSTs change notifications to `address`; the channel expires at `expiration` (max 7 days). Pass the same channelId on retry to replay the existing channel.

channelId.description: Caller-controlled UUID; also used as idempotency key.

address.description: HTTPS URL Drive will POST change notifications to.

ttlMs.description: Channel lifetime in ms. Drive caps at 7 days.

capabilities.name: upload_file
capabilities.description: Upload a file to Drive via multipart upload. `content` is the file body; set `encoding='base64'` for binary payloads. Optional `parents` places the file in a specific folder.

capabilities.name: create_folder
capabilities.description: Create a folder in Drive. Optionally nest under `parents`. Returns the new folder's id.

capabilities.name: delete_file
capabilities.description: Permanently delete a file or folder by id. Bypasses trash — the operation is irreversible.

capabilities.name: move_file
capabilities.description: Move a file/folder by changing its parents. Removes `removeParents` and adds `addParents` in a single PATCH. At least one of removeParents/addParents is required.

description: Read a Google Form's schema and paginate its responses for KB ingest, lead routing, or analytics. Returns answers keyed by questionId with the original item tree available for question→title joins.

capabilities.name: get_form
capabilities.description: Fetch the full Form resource by id. Returns info (title/description), the item tree (questions + sections), the current revisionId, and the public responderUri. Use the item tree to map answer questionIds back to human-readable question titles.

formId.description: Forms form id (the slug after /forms/d/ in the editor URL).

capabilities.name: list_responses
capabilities.description: List form responses with pagination. `filter` accepts the Forms timestamp grammar (e.g. `timestamp > "2026-01-01T00:00:00Z"`) for incremental ingest. Each response carries flattened `answers: {questionId: {value: string[]}}` plus the original payload at `raw`.

pageSize.description: Max responses to return in this page. Forms API caps at 5000.

pageToken.description: nextPageToken from a prior call to continue the same page sequence.

capabilities.name: get_response
capabilities.description: Fetch a single response by id — the common path when a Forms watch notification delivers only the responseId.

capabilities.name: create_form
capabilities.description: Create a new Google Form. Returns the freshly-created Form resource (formId, info, revisionId, responderUri). Only info.title/documentTitle are accepted at creation time per Forms API; use batch_update afterwards to add items.

title.description: Form title shown above the questions (info.title).

documentTitle.description: Drive document title (info.documentTitle). Defaults to `title` when omitted.

capabilities.name: batch_update
capabilities.description: Apply a batch of Forms `Request` objects to an existing form (add items, update info, move/delete items, etc.). The `requests` array is passed through unchanged to the Forms API — see Google's Forms batchUpdate request reference.

requests.description: Array of Forms `Request` objects passed through to the batchUpdate endpoint.

includeFormInResponse.description: When true, the response body includes the updated Form resource at `form`.

writeControl.description: Optional Forms WriteControl object (e.g. `{requiredRevisionId: 'rev_1'}`) to guard against concurrent edits.

description: Generate content, chat, create videos, and perform AI tasks with Google Gemini models.

auth.hint: Google Gemini API key.

capabilities.name: models.list
capabilities.description: List available Gemini models.

capabilities.name: chat.generate
capabilities.description: Chat with Gemini and generate text responses.

capabilities.name: content.generate
capabilities.description: Generate content using Gemini with advanced options.

capabilities.name: video.generate
capabilities.description: Generate videos using Gemini video generation models.

capabilities.name: image.generateFromImage
capabilities.description: Generate content from an input image.

capabilities.name: search.generateWithFile
capabilities.description: Generate content with file search capabilities.

capabilities.name: audio.textToSpeech
capabilities.description: Convert text to speech using Gemini.

description: Create Google Meet spaces, fetch post-meeting conference records, and read participants, recordings, and transcripts via the Google Meet REST API v2.

capabilities.name: spaces.create
capabilities.description: Create a Meet space and return its meet.google.com URL. The space lives until the calling user deletes it or it expires per Google retention rules.

config.description: Optional SpaceConfig: accessType (OPEN | TRUSTED | RESTRICTED), entryPointAccess (ALL | CREATOR_APP_ONLY), moderation, attendanceReport, artifactConfig, chatRestriction, presentRestriction, defaultJoinAsViewerType.

capabilities.name: spaces.get
capabilities.description: Read a Meet space by resource name (e.g. "spaces/abc-defg-hij") or by short meeting code.

capabilities.name: spaces.update
capabilities.description: Patch a Meet space (accessType, entryPointAccess, moderation toggles, artifactConfig, chat/present restrictions). Caller supplies updateMask to specify mutated fields.

updateMask.description: Comma-separated FieldMask of mutated fields, e.g. "config.accessType,config.moderation".

capabilities.name: spaces.endActiveConference
capabilities.description: Terminate the currently active conference inside a Meet space. No-op (HTTP 200) if no conference is active.

capabilities.name: conferenceRecords.list
capabilities.description: List conference records for meetings the calling user attended or hosted. Supports server-side filtering by space.name and end_time.

capabilities.name: conferenceRecords.get
capabilities.description: Read a conference record by resource name (e.g. "conferenceRecords/abc123").

capabilities.name: conferenceRecords.participants.list
capabilities.description: List participants for a finished conference, including anonymous and phone-dial-in attendees.

capabilities.name: conferenceRecords.recordings.list
capabilities.description: List recordings for a conference record. Each entry includes the Drive file id and DriveFileExportUri for downstream Drive fetches.

capabilities.name: conferenceRecords.recordings.get
capabilities.description: Read a single recording by resource name.

capabilities.name: conferenceRecords.transcripts.list
capabilities.description: List transcripts (auto-generated captions exports) for a conference record.

capabilities.name: conferenceRecords.transcripts.get
capabilities.description: Read a transcript by resource name; payload links to the Drive Doc holding the transcript text.

description: Manage Google Business Profile (formerly Google My Business): list accounts and locations, read customer reviews, and post owner replies.

capabilities.name: accounts.list
capabilities.description: List Business Profile accounts the authenticated user owns or co-manages.

capabilities.name: locations.list
capabilities.description: List locations under a Business Profile account (Business Information API).

accountId.description: Bare account id (the trailing segment of `accounts/{accountId}`).

readMask.description: Field mask selecting which Location fields to return, e.g. `name,title,storefrontAddress`.

capabilities.name: reviews.list
capabilities.description: List customer reviews for a location (legacy v4 endpoint — Google never migrated reviews onto the v1 split APIs).

orderBy.description: Sort order, e.g. `updateTime desc` or `rating desc`.

capabilities.name: reviews.get
capabilities.description: Get a single customer review by id.

capabilities.name: reviews.reply.create
capabilities.description: Create or replace the owner reply on a customer review (idempotent upsert on the review name).

capabilities.name: reviews.reply.delete
capabilities.description: Delete the owner reply on a customer review.

capabilities.name: localPosts.create
capabilities.description: Publish a Google Business Profile local post (status update, offer, event, or call-to-action) on a location.

callToAction.description: Optional { actionType, url } block, e.g. { actionType: "LEARN_MORE", url: "https://..." }.

event.description: For topicType=EVENT: { title, schedule: { startDate, endDate, ... } }.

media.description: Optional MediaItem list to attach images/video to the post.

capabilities.name: localPosts.delete
capabilities.description: Delete a local post from a location. Repeating the call on an already-deleted post yields 404 but is idempotent in effect.

capabilities.name: media.create
capabilities.description: Upload a photo or video to a Google Business Profile location via the v4 /media endpoint. Pass a sourceUrl Google can fetch (HTTPS, publicly reachable). For bytestream uploads use the /media:startUpload + PUT bytestream flow instead.

locationAssociation.description: Where the media attaches, e.g. { category: "EXTERIOR" } or { priceListItemId: "..." }.

sourceUrl.description: Public HTTPS URL Google should fetch the media from.

description.description: Optional caption shown alongside the media.

description: Search using Vertex AI Search (Discovery Engine).

auth.hint: Google Cloud API key with Vertex AI Search access. Provide project ID and Vertex AI Search app (engine) ID per request.

capabilities.name: search
capabilities.description: Run a Vertex AI Search (Discovery Engine) query against a configured search app/engine.

projectId.description: Google Cloud project ID hosting the Vertex AI Search engine.

userPseudoId.description: Pseudonymized identifier for the user (max 128 chars). Improves personalization.

description: Inspect URLs against the Google index, run Search Analytics queries, and manage verified sites and sitemaps for properties the connected identity owns in Google Search Console.

capabilities.name: urlInspection.index
capabilities.description: Inspect a URL against the Google index for a property in Search Console. Returns the indexing status, last crawl time, canonical URL, mobile usability, rich results status, and AMP analysis (POST /v1/urlInspection/index:inspect).

inspectionUrl.description: Fully-qualified URL to inspect. Must belong to the verified `siteUrl` property below.

siteUrl.description: Verified property the inspectionUrl belongs to. URL-prefix property (e.g. "https://example.com/") or domain property ("sc-domain:example.com").

languageCode.description: BCP-47 language code (e.g. "en-US") that controls the locale of human-readable strings in the response.

capabilities.name: searchAnalytics.query
capabilities.description: Run a Search Analytics query against a verified property. Pass startDate/endDate (ISO yyyy-MM-dd), optional dimensions (query, page, country, device, searchAppearance, date), filter groups, row limit, and aggregation type. Returns the rows Search Console emits with clicks, impressions, CTR, and average position (POST /webmasters/v3/sites/{siteUrl}/searchAnalytics/query).

siteUrl.description: Verified property identifier — URL-prefix or "sc-domain:" form.

startDate.description: Inclusive start date, ISO yyyy-MM-dd. Search Console data lags 2–3 days.

dimensions.description: Group-by dimensions, e.g. ["query","page"]. Omit for a single totals row.

type.description: Search type filter: "web" (default), "image", "video", "news", "discover", "googleNews".

dimensionFilterGroups.description: OR-grouped filters; each group is an AND of dimension/expression/operator filters.

aggregationType.description: "auto" (default) chooses byPage/byProperty per dimension set; "byPage" forces per-page aggregation.

rowLimit.description: Max rows per page; Search Console caps at 25000.

dataState.description: "final" (default, fully processed) or "all" (includes fresh-but-incomplete data from the last 1–2 days).

capabilities.name: sites.list
capabilities.description: List every site the connected identity has at least read access to in Search Console. Returns the siteUrl identifiers other capabilities consume, plus the permissionLevel per site (GET /webmasters/v3/sites).

capabilities.name: sites.add
capabilities.description: Add a site to the connected identity's Search Console account. The site will be unverified until ownership is proven through one of Search Console's verification methods (PUT /webmasters/v3/sites/{siteUrl}).

siteUrl.description: URL-prefix property ("https://example.com/") or domain property ("sc-domain:example.com") to add.

capabilities.name: sites.delete
capabilities.description: Remove a site from the connected identity's Search Console account. The site itself is not affected; only the connected identity's access is revoked (DELETE /webmasters/v3/sites/{siteUrl}).

siteUrl.description: Property identifier to remove — URL-prefix or "sc-domain:" form.

capabilities.name: sitemaps.list
capabilities.description: List every sitemap registered against a verified property in Search Console. Returns each sitemap's path, last-submitted time, last-downloaded time, type (sitemap/sitemapsIndex), and any errors/warnings (GET /webmasters/v3/sites/{siteUrl}/sitemaps).

sitemapIndex.description: Optional sitemap-index URL; if set, only sitemaps contained within that index are returned.

capabilities.name: sitemaps.submit
capabilities.description: Submit a sitemap to Search Console for a verified property. The feedPath must be a fully-qualified URL hosted on the site; Search Console fetches it asynchronously after the call returns (PUT /webmasters/v3/sites/{siteUrl}/sitemaps/{feedpath}).

siteUrl.description: Verified property identifier the sitemap belongs to.

feedpath.description: Fully-qualified sitemap URL, e.g. "https://example.com/sitemap.xml". The runtime URL-encodes this when substituting into the path.

capabilities.name: sitemaps.delete
capabilities.description: Remove a submitted sitemap from a verified property in Search Console. The sitemap file at feedpath is not touched — only Search Console's record of the submission is dropped (DELETE /webmasters/v3/sites/{siteUrl}/sitemaps/{feedpath}).

siteUrl.description: Verified property identifier the sitemap belongs to.

feedpath.description: Fully-qualified sitemap URL previously submitted, e.g. "https://example.com/sitemap.xml". The runtime URL-encodes this when substituting into the path.

description: Bind your agent's knowledge base or pricing/availability lookup to a live Google Sheet. Edit the sheet, and the agent picks up changes — no redeploys.

capabilities.name: list_rows
capabilities.description: Return rows from the connected sheet. Each row is keyed by the header cells declared at connect time.

capabilities.name: query_rows
capabilities.description: Return rows matching every key=value pair in `predicate` (string equality, case-insensitive).

capabilities.name: update_row
capabilities.description: Update a row identified by `rowKey` (the value in the configured key column). Patch is a {column: newValue} map. Returns conflict if the row changed since the agent last read it.

rowKey.description: Value in the key column identifying the row to update.

expectedFingerprint.description: Optional. The fingerprint the agent read on its last list_rows/query_rows call. If supplied and stale, the update is rejected with conflict.

capabilities.name: append_row
capabilities.description: Append rows to the end of `range` in `spreadsheetId`. `values` is a 2D array (rows × cells). `valueInputOption` defaults to USER_ENTERED so formulas + dates are parsed like a human-typed entry.

values.description: 2D array of cells; one inner array per appended row.

capabilities.name: clear_range
capabilities.description: Clear all cell values in `range` (formatting is preserved).

range.description: A1 notation of the range to clear.

capabilities.name: create_sheet
capabilities.description: Create a brand-new spreadsheet (workbook). Returns the new spreadsheetId. To add an additional tab inside an existing spreadsheet use the batchUpdate addSheet request (not modeled here).

description: Create presentations, refresh charts, and read Google Slides presentations.

capabilities.name: presentation.get
capabilities.description: Get a Google Slides presentation by ID.

capabilities.name: presentation.create
capabilities.description: Create a new Google Slides presentation.

capabilities.name: charts.refresh
capabilities.description: Refresh Sheets charts embedded in a presentation.

capabilities.name: presentation.update
capabilities.description: Apply a batch of Slides API edit requests (insertText, deleteObject, updateShapeProperties, etc.) to an existing presentation. Pass `requests` as an array of Slides batchUpdate Request objects; the API applies them atomically (POST /presentations/{presentationId}:batchUpdate).

requests.description: Array of Slides batchUpdate Request objects, e.g. [{ insertText: { objectId, text } }].

writeControl.description: Optional WriteControl object with required_revision_id for optimistic locking.

capabilities.name: slides.duplicate
capabilities.description: Duplicate an existing slide within a presentation. Issues a Slides batchUpdate with a `duplicateObject` request keyed by the slide's objectId (POST /presentations/{presentationId}:batchUpdate).

objectId.description: Object ID of the slide to duplicate (slides are page-level objects).

objectIds.description: Optional map of source-objectId -> desired-objectId for the duplicated children, letting callers pin stable IDs.

description: Manage tasks in Google Tasks task lists.

capabilities.name: tasklists.list
capabilities.description: List all task lists.

capabilities.name: tasklists.get
capabilities.description: Get a specific task list.

capabilities.name: tasks.list
capabilities.description: List tasks in a task list.

capabilities.name: tasks.get
capabilities.description: Get a specific task.

capabilities.name: tasks.create
capabilities.description: Create a new task in a task list.

capabilities.name: tasks.update
capabilities.description: Update an existing task.

capabilities.name: tasks.delete
capabilities.description: Delete a task.

capabilities.name: tasks.complete
capabilities.description: Mark a task as completed. Issues a PATCH against the task with status="completed"; Google records `completed` as the current time. To uncomplete, use tasks.update with status="needsAction".

capabilities.name: lists.create
capabilities.description: Create a new task list owned by the authenticated user.

title.description: Display title of the new task list.

description: Generate content and images using Gemini and Imagen models on Google Vertex AI.

auth.hint: Google Cloud API key with Vertex AI permissions.

capabilities.name: content.generate
capabilities.description: Generate content using Gemini model.

capabilities.name: content.generateWithFiles
capabilities.description: Generate content with file attachments (images, PDFs, text, audio, video).

capabilities.name: image.generate
capabilities.description: Generate images using Imagen model.

capabilities.name: models.list
capabilities.description: List available models in the location.

capabilities.name: content.countTokens
capabilities.description: Count tokens for a given prompt.

description: Send messages to Google Chat spaces and direct messages, fetch message details, add members to spaces, list/search messages, and locate space members.

capabilities.name: send.amessage
capabilities.description: Send a message to a Google Chat space or DM. Pass the parent space (e.g. "spaces/AAAA1234") and a Chat message payload (text or cardsV2).

message.description: A Chat Message resource. Most callers set { text } or { cardsV2 }.

threadKey.description: Optional thread key for grouping replies under a synthetic thread.

messageReplyOption.description: Controls thread reply behavior when message.thread is set.

capabilities.name: get.direct.message.details
capabilities.description: Read a direct message by resource name. Direct messages live under the DM space ("spaces/{dmId}/messages/{messageId}").

capabilities.name: add.aspace.member
capabilities.description: Add a human user or Chat app as a member to a space. Provide the parent space and a Membership resource (member.name = "users/{userId}").

membership.description: Membership resource. Typically { member: { name: "users/123", type: "HUMAN" } } or { groupMember: { name: "groups/xyz" } }.

capabilities.name: get.message.details
capabilities.description: Read a Chat message by full resource name ("spaces/{space}/messages/{message}"). Returns the Message resource including text, sender, thread, and any cardsV2 payload.

capabilities.name: search.messages
capabilities.description: List messages in a space, optionally filtered with the Chat API filter syntax (e.g. "createTime > \"2024-01-01T00:00:00Z\"") and ordered by createTime.

capabilities.name: find.member
capabilities.description: List or filter memberships of a space to locate a specific user, group, or app. Use filter (e.g. "member.type = \"HUMAN\"") to narrow results.

capabilities.name: message.update
capabilities.description: Edit a previously sent message in a Google Chat space. Pass the full message resource name and an updateMask listing the fields being modified (e.g. "text" or "cardsV2"). Body is the partial Message resource holding the new values.

updateMask.description: Comma-separated list of fields to update, e.g. "text" or "cardsV2,attachment".

message.description: Partial Message resource carrying the new field values referenced by updateMask.

capabilities.name: message.delete
capabilities.description: Delete a message from a Google Chat space. Only the authenticated user's own messages can be deleted with user-token credentials; Chat apps can delete their own messages.

force.description: When true, also delete threaded replies; defaults to false.

capabilities.name: space.create
capabilities.description: Create a named Google Chat space. Pass a Space resource with displayName and spaceType (e.g. "SPACE" for a named group space). For DM creation use spaces.setup; this capability covers the spaces.create endpoint for human-named spaces.

space.description: Space resource. Typically { displayName: "Engineering", spaceType: "SPACE" } or { spaceType: "GROUP_CHAT" }.

requestId.description: Optional client-supplied request ID; Chat uses it to deduplicate retries server-side.

description: Search, read, create, and update Gorgias support tickets, messages, and customers for ecommerce help desks.

capabilities.name: tickets.search
capabilities.description: List tickets, optionally filtered by status/channel/assignee/customer. Pass any Gorgias ticket-list query parameter.

capabilities.name: tickets.get
capabilities.description: Read a single Gorgias ticket by id.

capabilities.name: tickets.create
capabilities.description: Create a Gorgias ticket. Pass the full ticket payload as defined by Gorgias (channel, customer, messages, etc.).

capabilities.name: tickets.update
capabilities.description: Update a Gorgias ticket. Pass any subset of mutable ticket fields (status, priority, assignee_user, tags, etc.).

capabilities.name: messages.create

description: Send an arbitrary HTTP request to any http(s) URL. Useful for hitting one-off APIs, probes, public JSON feeds, or operator-controlled webhooks. No shared auth — the agent supplies the full URL, method, headers, and body at invocation time.

headers.description: Optional request headers. Header names are lower-cased before send.

query.description: Optional query-string parameters. Values are coerced to string; arrays become repeated keys.

capabilities.name: request.send
capabilities.description: Issue a POST/PUT/PATCH/DELETE request to a URL. The agent supplies the body verbatim — pass an object for JSON, a string for raw text. The idempotency key is forwarded as the `Idempotency-Key` header; receivers that honour it (Stripe, Square, many SaaS APIs) dedupe automatically.

url.description: Absolute http(s) URL to call.

headers.description: Optional request headers. Header names are lower-cased before send.

query.description: Optional query-string parameters appended to the URL.

body.description: Request body. Objects are JSON-encoded with `content-type: application/json`; strings are sent verbatim with the caller-supplied content-type (defaulting to text/plain).

timeoutMs.description: Per-request timeout in milliseconds. Defaults to 15000, capped at 60000.

Supply either a cross-drive parentReference (driveId + id) or a same-site target parent id via targetParentId; optionally rename via name.

description: Manage Weaviate vector-database schemas (collections), CRUD individual objects, run vector / hybrid / BM25 search via GraphQL, and batch-insert objects against a Weaviate Cloud or self-hosted cluster.

auth.hint: Weaviate Cloud cluster API key. Create one under the cluster details page at https://console.weaviate.cloud. Self-hosted clusters must enable the api-key auth module.

capabilities.name: schema.list
capabilities.description: List every collection (class) currently defined on the cluster, with its full property schema and vectorizer config.

capabilities.name: schema.get
capabilities.description: Fetch the schema definition for a single collection (class) by name.

className.description: Weaviate class / collection name (capitalised by convention).

capabilities.name: schema.create
capabilities.description: Create a new collection (class) with the supplied property + vectorizer config. The body must be a Weaviate class definition object (class, vectorizer, properties, …).

vectorizer.description: Vectorizer module id, e.g. text2vec-openai, text2vec-cohere, none.

properties.description: Ordered property list — each item is { name, dataType[], description?, indexFilterable?, indexSearchable?, moduleConfig? }.

capabilities.name: schema.delete
capabilities.description: Delete a collection (class) and every object stored under it. Irreversible.

capabilities.name: objects.list
capabilities.description: List objects in a collection. Supports limit/offset/after-cursor pagination and the `include=vector,classification` parameter.

after.description: Cursor — UUID of the last object from the previous page.

include.description: Comma-separated extras to inline: vector, classification, featureProjection.

capabilities.name: objects.get
capabilities.description: Fetch a single object by UUID within a collection. Pass include=vector to inline the embedding.

capabilities.name: objects.create
capabilities.description: Insert one object. Body must include `class` and `properties`; pass `vector` to skip server-side vectorization, or `id` to assign a deterministic UUID (the recommended dedupe path).

id.description: Optional deterministic UUID — when supplied, repeat inserts on the same UUID return 422 instead of creating duplicates.

vectors.description: Named-vector map for collections configured with multiple vector spaces.

capabilities.name: objects.update
capabilities.description: Merge-update an object: properties supplied in the body overwrite their counterparts, untouched properties are preserved (PATCH semantics).

capabilities.name: objects.replace
capabilities.description: Replace an object in place (PUT semantics): every property must be present in the body, omitted properties are cleared.

capabilities.name: objects.delete
capabilities.description: Delete a single object by UUID.

capabilities.name: graphql.query
capabilities.description: Run an arbitrary GraphQL query against the cluster. Vector search, hybrid search, BM25, aggregations, and `Explore` are all expressed as GraphQL queries — the caller composes the query string.

query.description: GraphQL query string. Example: `{ Get { Article(nearText: { concepts: ["AI"] }, limit: 5) { title _additional { id distance } } } }`.

capabilities.name: batch.objects.create
capabilities.description: Insert a batch of objects in one round-trip. Body is `{ objects: [...] }` where each item matches the single-object body. The server returns per-item success/error; the caller must inspect the result array.

objects.description: Up to ~100 objects per request (cluster-configurable). Each item carries class, properties, optional id/vector/vectors/tenant.

consistencyLevel.description: ONE | QUORUM | ALL — overrides the cluster default.

capabilities.name: batch.objects.delete
capabilities.description: Delete every object in a collection matching a where-filter. Body is `{ match: { class, where } }`. Returns a summary of matched / deleted / failed counts.

where.description: Weaviate where-filter operator tree (path, operator, value*).

output.description: minimal | verbose — verbose lists per-object outcomes.

capabilities.name: meta.get
capabilities.description: Fetch cluster metadata: version, hostname, enabled modules and their configs. Useful for capability discovery.

capabilities.name: nodes.list
capabilities.description: Return per-node cluster status: name, status, version, shard counts. Useful for health and rebalancing dashboards.

capabilities.name: classes.update
capabilities.description: Update a class/collection schema in place. Body is a full class definition object; non-mutable settings (vectorizer, properties) must match the existing class — only invertedIndexConfig, replicationConfig, vectorIndexConfig and description are practically mutable.

capabilities.name: schema.shards
capabilities.description: List shards for a class with their READY/READONLY/INDEXING status. Used to drive rebalancing and read-only failover decisions.

capabilities.name: backups.create
capabilities.description: Create a backup snapshot to a configured backend (filesystem / s3 / gcs / azure). Body carries backup id and optional include/exclude class lists. The backup_id is the caller-supplied dedupe key.

backend.description: Backup backend module id, e.g. filesystem, s3, gcs, azure.

capabilities.name: backups.restore
capabilities.description: Restore a previously-created backup snapshot. Specify backend + id; optional include/exclude narrows the restore scope.

nodeMapping.description: Map original node names to current cluster nodes.

description: Search and enrich contacts and companies, plus buyer-intent signals, business Scoops, and company news, via the ZoomInfo GTM Data API. Search is free; enrich consumes bulk-data credits.

capabilities.name: contact.search
capabilities.description: Search the contact database by firmographic/persona criteria. Returns ranked matches with stable contactId values and basic info only (no emails/phones). Free. Pass contactId to contact.enrich for full detail.

data.description: Search criteria wrapped under `data`, e.g. { companyName, jobTitle: ["VP Sales"], managementLevel, zipCode }. Resolve valid field names via lookup.search_fields (entity=contact, fieldType=input).

sort.description: Sort field; prefix with - for descending.

capabilities.name: company.search
capabilities.description: Search the company database by firmographic filters (industry, revenue, employee count, geography, tech stack). Returns basic company info and stable companyId values. Free.

data.description: Search criteria under `data`, e.g. { companyName, industry, employeeCount, revenue, location, technologies }. Resolve fields via lookup.search_fields (entity=company, fieldType=input).

capabilities.name: intent.search
capabilities.description: Search for companies showing buyer-intent signals across 1–50 intent topics. Returns ranked companies with intent signal scores. Free.

data.description: Criteria under `data`, must include topics: ["cybersecurity", "cloud migration"] plus optional filters.

capabilities.name: scoops.search
capabilities.description: Search real-time business-intelligence signals (Scoops: hiring, expansion, tech changes) across ZoomInfo companies. Free; each scoop counts against the record limit.

data.description: Scoop filter criteria under `data`.

capabilities.name: news.search
capabilities.description: Search news articles across ZoomInfo companies. All filters optional but at least one must be set. Free; each article counts as one record. No sort param.

data.description: News filter criteria under `data`, e.g. { companyId, keywords }.

capabilities.name: contact.enrich
capabilities.description: Enrich up to 25 contacts with full detail (email, phone, jobTitle, 300+ fields). Best practice: contact.search first, then pass contactId. CONSUMES 1 bulk-data credit per matched record returned (waived if under management). `data` carries matchPersonInput + outputFields (+ optional requiredFields).

data.description: Enrich body under `data`, e.g. { matchPersonInput: [{ contactId } | { firstName, lastName, companyName, emailAddress }], outputFields: ["id","email","phone","jobTitle"], requiredFields: [] }.

capabilities.name: company.enrich
capabilities.description: Enrich up to 25 companies with 300+ data points (firmographics, technographics). Best practice: company.search first, then pass companyId. CONSUMES 1 bulk-data credit per matched record. `data` carries matchCompanyInput + outputFields.

data.description: Enrich body under `data`, e.g. { matchCompanyInput: [{ companyId } | { companyName, website }], outputFields: ["id","name","website","industry","employeeCount","revenue"], requiredFields: [] }.

capabilities.name: intent.enrich
capabilities.description: Fetch intent signals for a specific known company (companyId, companyName, or companyWebsite) across 1–50 topics. CONSUMES bulk-data credits per enriched company.

data.description: Body under `data`, e.g. { companyId, topics: [...] }.

capabilities.name: scoops.enrich
capabilities.description: Fetch Scoops for a specific known company (at least one company identifier). CONSUMES 1 credit per enriched company; each returned scoop counts against the record limit.

data.description: Body under `data`, e.g. { companyId }.

capabilities.name: news.enrich
capabilities.description: Fetch categorized news coverage for a specific known company (at least one company identifier). CONSUMES bulk-data credits per enriched company.

data.description: Body under `data`, e.g. { companyId }.

capabilities.name: lookup.data
capabilities.description: Retrieve enumerated valid values for a filter field (industries, regions, job functions, management levels, technologies, intent topics). Use to build valid search bodies. Free.

fieldName.description: The filter field to enumerate, e.g. industry, managementLevel.

capabilities.name: lookup.search_fields
capabilities.description: Discover the valid input and output field names for a search/enrich entity. REQUIRED to build correct search/enrich bodies and enrich outputFields. Free.

capabilities.name: usage.get
capabilities.description: Return the current user’s API usage and limits (credits consumed, request counts, entitlements). Free.
